name: Toga Tarou
source:
Stage director for "The Wandering Angel."

He handles things behind the scenes for the production of [I]Au Revoir[/I]. He's very irritated that [url=/c129986]Shin'ichi Bando[/url], in charge of the props, seems to have gone AWOL.

[Edited from in-game TIPS]

He and Takaya accidentally lock [url=/c73540]Achi[/url] and [url=/c73545]Hitomi[/url] inside the troupe's storage building while hiding from The Man with the Cane.
